correctness.rationale: For F_a(B) with centrally symmetric B, the slice of F+s(-F) at height z=z0−s z1 belongs to scale 1+s−(1−a)(z0+s z1), bounded above by 1+s−(1−a)|z|; boundary choices (z0,z1)=(z,0) for z>=0 and (0,-z/s) for z<=0 attain equality, so slices are exactly [1+s−(1−a)|z|]B. Integrating over [-s,1] yields vol_{n-1}(B)*(2(1+s)^n−(1+as)^n−(a+s)^n)/(n(1−a)) for a<1. Coefficient extraction and original volume ratio give (2−a^j−a^{n−j})/(1−a^n), with j=0,n and a=0,1 handled. Monotonicity of h_u(t)=t/(exp(ut)−1) proves strict taper decrease in interior j; exact second finite differences show strict index concavity for 0<a<1; s=1 yields reflected difference body ratio. With a_n=exp(-c/n), normalized ratio tends 2/(1+exp(-c/2)); c=0 prism boundary exact. Independently checked 160 exact rational Minkowski polynomial/coefficient identities for 2<=n<=11, a in {0,1/4,1/2,3/4}, s in {0,1/3,1,3}.
